instruction: Calling `pop()` on an empty `Stack` (in `ds/stack.py`) crashes with an `AttributeError` instead of raising `IndexError`. The empty-stack guard is missing, so the code dereferences the head even when the stack has no elements. Popping a non-empty stack is unaffected.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds/stack.py b/ds/stack.py
--- a/ds/stack.py
+++ b/ds/stack.py
@@ -13,6 +13,8 @@
         self._head = Node(item, self._head)
 
     def pop(self):
+        if self._head is None:
+            raise IndexError("pop from empty stack")
         item = self._head.value
         self._head = self._head.nxt
         return item
